Mega Evolution series · MEG

Mega Evolution

Released September 26, 2025 · 188 cards

StandardExpanded

Mega Evolution is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Mega Evolution series, released in English on September 26, 2025. Its main set has 132 cards, plus 56 secret rares numbered beyond the set (188 in total). It includes 152 Pokémon, 36 Trainer and 0 Energy cards, and is legal in the Standard and Expanded formats.
